full_prompt_en: The image is a square high-energy photographic or composite image of a black camera with a large lens suspended against a burst of blue-white motion lines. The camera sits just right of center, facing slightly left so the round lens points toward the viewer. Its dark body, top viewfinder hump, controls, and circular lens rim remain relatively sharp. Metallic gray highlights outline the glass rings and front edge. Behind it, long pale streaks rush inward from every side toward a vanishing point slightly left of the camera. The streaks vary in width and brightness, from nearly white bands to soft gray-blue lines and deep charcoal gaps. They make the background feel like a tunnel or rapid forward movement, though no literal road or building is identified. The camera casts or merges into a dark soft shadow along the lower right, anchoring it against the luminous flow. The palette is restricted to black, silver gray, icy blue, and white. Bright light is concentrated in the radial background, especially toward the upper left. The product surface reflects a few thin highlights but does not become uniformly glossy. The composition is off-center, balancing the camera's dense dark mass against the bright convergence of lines. Fine details on the body are secondary to the strong circular lens and directional burst. The edges of the streaks are deliberately blurred, while the camera itself is comparatively crisp. The overall effect is dramatic and kinetic, with visual speed conveyed by radial smear and contrast rather than by visible physical movement of the main object. It reads as a stylized celebration of photographic equipment and optical motion.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、高能量的摄影或合成画面，一台带大镜头的黑相机悬在蓝白运动光痕的爆发前。相机略偏中央右侧，微朝左，使圆镜头指向观者。深色机身、顶部取景器凸起、控制件与圆镜头环保持相对清晰。金属灰亮边勾出玻璃圈与前沿。身后长浅光痕从四边冲向略偏相机左侧的消失点。光痕宽度与亮度不同，从近白条到柔灰蓝线及深炭缝，令背景像隧道或高速前行，但没有指定道路或建筑。相机在右下融入一片深柔阴影，使其落在发亮的流动中。配色限于黑、银灰、冰蓝与白。亮光集中在放射背景，尤其向左上。产品表面反射几道细高光，却没有全身均匀光泽。构图偏心，以相机浓密深体块平衡亮线的汇聚。机身细节次于强圆镜头与方向性爆发。光痕边缘有意模糊，相机本身则相对清脆。整体戏剧性强且动感足，以放射模糊和反差而非主体可见的物理运动传达速度。画面像对摄影器材和光学运动的风格化呈现。
style_prompt_en: Graphic photographic compositing holds one dark, crisp focal object against a radial field of cool motion streaks. Long silver, icy blue, white, and charcoal bands converge off-center, varying in width and blur. The focal silhouette stays materially readable through narrow metallic highlights and distinct circular edges. Strong contrast between stationary sharpness and background smear suggests speed without needing literal action. A soft shadow or dark base keeps the object from floating weightlessly. The palette remains cool and restricted. The effect is kinetic and polished, with directional light and optical blur organizing the frame around one clear mass.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化摄影合成把一件深而清晰的焦点物置于冷色放射运动光痕前。银、冰蓝、白与炭色长带在偏心处汇聚，宽窄和模糊程度各异。焦点剪影通过狭窄金属亮边和明确圆边保持材料可读。静止清晰与背景拖影的强对照无需具体动作也能暗示速度。柔影或深底防止物体毫无重量地漂浮。配色保持冷而受限。效果动感且光洁，以定向光与光学模糊围绕一块清楚体量组织画幅。
theme_en: A dark camera against a radial burst of blue-white motion streaks
theme_zh: 一台深色相机置于蓝白色放射运动光痕前
name: Fast shutter speed
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
